Package hec.model

Class StreamSegment

java.lang.Object
hec.model.StreamSegment
All Implemented Interfaces:
AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, StreamReferenceHolder, Serializable
public class StreamSegment extends Object implements AsciiSerializable, StreamReferenceHolder
Simple container to identify a segment on a stream element either a station or a coordinate may be used to identify the ends of the segment
